mobbin:272048bd-060c-49bf-b4ad-e37b5d2a4.summary: Before Enter classroom, the learner opens Test devices, runs a short AV sample with a scripted prompt, confirms Yes/No on seeing themselves, then returns to a hub with Camera and mic checkmarked.
steps: Hub — Camera and mic vs Network
AV test — Recording in progress + say prompt
AV test — Can you see yourself Yes/No
steal: Hub splits Camera and mic vs Network and device with fix-tips copy (step Hub — Camera and mic vs Network).
5-second AV sample: won't be saved or shared + Start test (step AV test — Start test CTA).
During capture: Recording in progress, Try saying…, and a progress bar (step AV test — Recording in progress).
Self-confirm Yes/No with If not, we'll help you fix it + New test; hub then shows green check on Camera and mic (steps Yes/No and Hub — checkmarked).
avoid: Hub screens repeat (steps 1 and 3) with little new state — recycle steps confuse operators running a daily room self-test.
mobbin:272048bd-060c-49bf-b4ad-e37b5d2a4.fit: Replaces the planned per-room self-test outside SRV: guided cam/mic sample + Yes/No confirm + checkmarked health summary before session; not an SRV tab change.
